en: Ferdinand Magellan did not discover the Philippines, as the islands were already inhabited and he only arrived in 1521 before being killed in Mactan.
Although a national hero, Jose Rizal was never president; Emilio Aguinaldo was the first president of the Philippine Republic.
The Philippine flag was not designed by an American, but by Emilio Aguinaldo and sewn by Marcela Agoncillo and her daughters.
Independence Day was originally celebrated on July 4 until President Diosdado Macapagal changed it to June 12 in 1962.
Filipino is the sole national language, but the Philippine Constitution recognizes 19 regional languages as auxiliary official languages for education.
The sampaguita, not the waling-waling, is the official national flower of the Philippines, having been declared as such in 1934.
The legislative branch, not the executive branch, is responsible for making laws, while the executive branch enforces them.
Fe del Mundo was not the first female doctor globally, but she was the first Asian woman admitted to Harvard Medical School.
The Tinikling dance did not originate from Spanish royalty, but was created by local farmers in Leyte mimicking the movement of tikling birds.
Spain colonized the Philippines for 333 years, not 100 years, from Miguel Lopez de Legazpi's arrival in 1565 until 1898.
The carabao is the national animal not because it is wild, but because it is a domesticated water buffalo essential to Filipino farming.
The Senate has exactly 24 elected members, whereas the House of Representatives has over 300 members depending on the legislative districts.
